Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: currency-converter-pro
Version: 1.0.1

The currency-converter-pro skill bundle provides legitimate currency exchange functionality using a public API (open.er-api.com). The Python script (scripts/currency.py) handles data fetching and processing safely, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection. While the subprocess module is imported, it is unused, and the overall logic is well-aligned with the stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill's code, runtime instructions, and network access are consistent with a currency-conversion utility that uses the public open.er-api.com service; it does not request credentials or install extra components.

dimensions.detail: Name/description advertise real-time and historical currency conversion; the included script fetches rates from open.er-api.com and implements convert/rates/top/historical commands — all required behavior is present and coherent with the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the provided Python script and shows example commands. Note: the script imports subprocess but never uses it (benign but unnecessary).

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it fetches rates from the public open.er-api.com API and performs local calculations. Before installing, consider: (1) review the provided Python file yourself or run it in an isolated/sandboxed environment since it will make outbound HTTPS requests; (2) confirm you are comfortable with network calls to open.er-api.com (no data exfiltration is evident, but network access is required); (3) remove the unused subprocess import or audit further if you plan to embed the script in a sensitive environment; and (4) if you need production guarantees, prefer code from a known upstream or pin to a vetted release.
